title: gotit TUI per-project config (v1)
description: Schema for tests/e2e/gotit.yaml — the small file the gotit binary reads to learn a project's CLI wiring.

binary_name.description: Bare CLI name, used in spec command tokens (e.g. `mytool`).

build_path.description: Go package path passed to `go build` (e.g. `./cmd/mytool`).

env_prefix.description: Uppercase prefix for isolation env vars: <PREFIX>_HOME, <PREFIX>_E2E_PROJECT_ROOT, <PREFIX>_E2E_FEATURES.

specs_dir.description: Directory holding YAML spec files. Default: tests/e2e/specs.

fixtures_dir.description: Directory holding repo fixtures. Default: tests/e2e/testdata/repos.

features_file.description: Path to the feature-flag allowlist YAML. Default: tests/e2e/features.yaml.

results_dir.description: Directory for JSONL run logs. Default: tests/e2e/results.
